title: Treatment & Care
content: Millions of Americans are living with diabetes, but your treatment plan should be made to meet your own needs and health goals. We want to give people living with diabetes and their loved ones the information about the latest on how diabetes is treated to make decisions about their treatment plans. Understanding what treatments are available and talking to your health care team, can help you make sure your treatment plan is meeting your needs and changes as your needs change. Learn how to check your blood glucose (blood sugar) with the latest tools. Get more information about diabetes medications and how they work. With your support, the American Diabetes Association® can continue our lifesaving work to make breakthroughs in research and provide people with the resources they need to fight diabetes.
